audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[4].side and [6].side read Yone and phases[5].side read Skill, while content win[4], win[5] and win[6] all read Zed and the packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.why: Level 6 through two items is Zed's mark window in every why on the page — phases[4].why itself describes Death Mark coming online. Rows 0-3 are Skill in both layers and were left alone.
audit.corrected: phases[4], [5] and [6] side set to Zed; no win[N] edits, they already read Zed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line says the matchup never names a single Yone ability, and the stage gates carried no cooldowns.
audit.why: Mortal Steel 4s at 450 range, dashes and knocks up only at 2 stacks; Spirit Cleave a flat 14s cone that shields more per champion hit; Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10; Fate Sealed 120/100/80 at 1000 range.
audit.corrected: Names and the 22s / 14s numbers written across cooldowns, spikes, whys and the phase rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and one gap. The page twice credited Yone's passive with "double-crit sustain" — it has no healing; and spikes[0] said he "can only recall it to the marked spot", which is vague about what actually happens.
audit.why: Riot passive text: magic damage on every second attack plus increased crit chance, no heal. Soul Unbound: "Yone's spirit leaves his body behind... When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit." His shield comes from Spirit Cleave, not the passive.
audit.corrected: Sustain claim replaced with the Spirit Cleave shield; the snap-back stated plainly — fight where the body stands, because that is where he is going.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint) and dosFull[2].d claimed a guarantee with no number.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his kit and the only real window.
audit.corrected: 22s and the flat 14s Spirit Cleave written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles.

notes: The packet's defect line was right: the matchup named none of Yone's abilities. All five now appear with real numbers (Mortal Steel 4s/450, Spirit Cleave flat 14s, Soul Unbound 22s at rank 1, Fate Sealed 1000 range). Two factual fixes: Yone's passive was credited with 'double-crit sustain' — it heals nothing, it deals magic damage on every second attack and raises crit chance, and the shield is Spirit Cleave; and spikes[0] mis-stated Soul Unbound as a recall to a marked spot when Riot's text is that the spirit is forced back to his body, which is the actual coaching point (fight where the body stands). Chart rows 4, 5 and 6 moved to Zed to match content win[] and the packet; no win[N] edits were needed.
